user_query: Analyze this protein sequence for likely function and subcellular localization. Pay particular attention to N-terminal signal peptides, transmembrane helices, membrane topology, domain architecture, homolog-supported annotations, and whether it is an integral membrane protein or a soluble enzyme. Distinguish direct sequence evidence from homology-based inference.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.
